meeting.title: Sylvera go-live readiness review
meeting.summary: Go-live readiness review with Sylvera. Training is complete and adoption is good. The only remaining blocker is the parity validation against Looker: six dashboards still need their numbers checked. Callum committed to finishing the parity checks and delivering formal sign-off by Friday July 3rd, keeping the July 8th go-live on track.
action_items: Callum to finish parity checks on the remaining six dashboards and deliver formal sign-off by Friday July 3rd
key_decisions: Go-live date of July 8th holds, contingent on parity sign-off landing by July 3rd
meeting.notes: Discrepancies found so far were all timezone-related and have been resolved in the dbt models. No open data issues.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Hi both — this is the readiness review, so let's walk the checklist. Training first: how did the second session land?

transcript.speaker: Freya Nilsen
transcript.text: Really well. Most of the analytics team is already building in Quarry day to day, which is more than I expected at this stage.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: That's great adoption. Okay, the big remaining item: parity validation against Looker. Callum, where are we?

transcript.speaker: Callum Reid
transcript.text: I've validated fourteen of the twenty dashboards. Six left — the carbon ratings pack and the two revenue ones.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Any discrepancies in the fourteen you've done?

transcript.speaker: Callum Reid
transcript.text: Two, both timezone-related. Your team fixed them in the dbt models last week and they re-validated clean.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Good. So what's realistic for the remaining six? Go-live is pencilled for the 8th and I don't want sign-off landing the night before.

transcript.speaker: Callum Reid
transcript.text: I've blocked out Thursday for it. I'll finish the parity checks on the remaining six dashboards and get you formal sign-off by Friday, July 3rd.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Friday the 3rd works — that gives us two clear working days of buffer before go-live.

transcript.speaker: Freya Nilsen
transcript.text: And to be explicit: if parity sign-off is in by the 3rd, we're confirming July 8th as the go-live date?

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Confirmed. July 8th holds, contingent only on that sign-off.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Brilliant. Anything else? Comms plan for the wider team is already drafted on your side, right Freya?

transcript.speaker: Freya Nilsen
transcript.text: Yes, that's ready to go, no help needed there.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Then we're in good shape. Speak Friday when the sign-off lands.
